shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal register band with repeated motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figural carving with profile creatures, feather/wing-like detailing and a small disc, and both have a banded horizontal register of repeated forms, but these are generic correspondences. A shows large detailed anthropomorphic winged figures with meticulously patterned, naturalistic feathering and beaded garments in a dense overlapping composition, while B shows small, highly schematic isolated animals (quadruped, bird-like creature, crouching figure) scattered on an empty ground beneath a row of arch/loop signs — a wholly different repertoire, scale relationship and drawing convention.
